changelog.title: A sharper Creative Director
changelog.desc: Your Creative Director now works from up to date Instagram, LinkedIn, email and Substack know-how, including what reaches new people, searchable captions, and what to measure. Director Chat can also help you read your results, turn real proof into posts, and choose a keyword people actually search. Reel scripts now also pick from five formats that work well (tutorial with split screen, list, breakdown, storytelling with b-roll, visual talking head).

changelog.title: Trial reels are now in the Studio
changelog.desc: Pick Trial Reel as the Format on any content card and your Creative Director plans a no-talking b-roll reel with several on-screen hooks to test on people who don't follow you yet. There's also a new Trial Reel Guide in Guides that walks through the method. Director Chat knows it too, so ask it what trial reels to make for your offer.

changelog.title: A simpler content card
changelog.desc: Content cards are now one page instead of three tabs. The basics sit at the top, then Write it yourself, then Get AI help, with sections you can open and close. Nothing was removed, it's just easier to find things.

changelog.title: New Later column in your Content Planner
changelog.desc: Your Content Planner now has a Later column, the first one on the board. It's a parking spot for ideas you don't want to lose but aren't ready to plan yet. Brain dump here, then move anything to Ideas when you're ready. You can also park an idea from Ideas with its Later button.
